XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Air conditioner fan failure at any speed
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: FAN | PASSENGER COMPARTMENT | AIR CONDITIONING | CLIMATE | HEATING | AIR | CONDITIONED | COLD | HOT | WORKING | INACTIVE | INACTIVE | NONE | SPEED |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Air conditioning

  • Device: Cabin fan (air conditioning/heating)

  • Fault: Cabin fan (air conditioning/heating) inactive; does not operate at any speed.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: - -

  • Cause: Cabin fan (air conditioning/heating) blocked

• Action: Check the condition of the cabin fan (air conditioning/heating) and clean it if necessary

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The fan is located beneath the glove compartment on the passenger side and can be accessed by removing a carpeted cover.
